title: Missile sculptures bearing North Korean flag removed from northern Seoul festival
caption:
A lantern festival along a Seoul stream took down an antiwar installation after residents protested North Korean flags on mock missiles. Organizers admitted they never inspected the finished sculptures before opening night.

Source: Koreaherald - Missile sculptures bearing North Korean flag removed from northern Seoul festival
